rules: Official-modern (RULES.md): 12-card bag, 1/21 bonus with window-first draw, 12288 ends the game.

OLD.what: website AI at the start of this work: V4 model (dist/models/ntuple-v4.bin), 3-ply expectimax with a 24000-node budget and iterative deepening, no cutoff, no clamp

NEW.what: current website AI: V23 model (dist/models/ntuple-v23.bin), 5-ply with probability cutoff 0.01, clamped leaves, complete depth every move

notes: Native C++ (training/v24-acceptance/game.cpp). The website also has a 160 ms soft time limit; browser timing (V17-V23) shows the NEW search completes 5 plies well inside it on desktop, and OLD's node budget is emulated. OLD node counting follows the C++ search, not byte-for-byte the old JS code.
endpoint: Normal opening to 12288 or death; milestones 1536/3072/6144/12288, final score, moves; 50000-move guard raises an error.

primary.P1: reach 6144: NEW vs OLD, exact McNemar
primary.P2: reach 12288: NEW vs OLD, exact McNemar

multiplicity: Holm across P1-P3. No interim analysis.
secondary: 1536/3072 rates, rates with Wilson intervals, CPU per move, depth completed by OLD.
scope: Paired comparison on one set of openings; not a claim about the official app; no mobile or real-app measurements.
